_comment: Synthetic MINIMUM selection aggregate for Issue #1705 (dominated-branch collapse). Two branches feed a MINIMUM aggregate: the RELU branch (always >= 0) is analytically dominated because a MINIMUM can never select it while the ABSOLUTE-scaled-by-(-1) branch (always <= 0) is available. Fixtures only - no engine behaviour change. Input neurons are implicit (referenced as input-N), matching the production convention in ../../remove_neuron_propagation/network.json.
